name: signal
why: signal wants one thing: a number. heyphony holds one and catches its texts, so the signup code that would normally need a phone in your hand arrives in an inbox an agent can read. that is the whole trick, and it is why this getter lives in the package with the number.
flow: signup on a durable but idle android spawnable, with the did as the number
the sms code lands at heyphony instead of a handset, and the agent reads it on the desktop
the phone owns the account and can then be parked: it stays the identity, not a babysitter
the desktop links to it as a secondary device, so the agent's own machine is a signal endpoint

phone-signup.what: the android spawnable becomes the phone of record, and heyphony reads the code
phone-signup.why_preferred: a phone-shaped device doing the signup is the shape signal expects, and the device being durable-but-idle costs nothing: it holds the identity, it does not have to stay awake

steps.about: install signal on the spawnable and enter the did as the number
steps.cmd: adb install org.thoughtcrime.securesms  # or the app store, on the spawnable

steps.about: signal texts a code to the did; it never reaches a handset, it reaches heyphony
steps.note: read the code from the inbox, not from a phone, because the phone is ours and idle

steps.about: type the code into the spawnable and finish signup

link-desktop.what: the agent's own desktop joins as a linked device, so it can send and read
link-desktop.why_preferred: linking keeps one identity: the phone stays primary and the desktop is a secondary device, which is exactly the relationship a person has with their laptop

steps.about: ask the bridge for a device qr, named for the machine it belongs to
scan it from the phone that owns the account

register-number.what: register the did straight from signal-cli, with no phone of record at all
register-number.why_risky: signal is notably less strict about voip numbers than whatsapp or google, so this can work, but there is no device of record behind it. expect a challenge, never a promise

steps.about: register, using the sms that heyphony catches
steps.note: if a captcha appears it has to be solved in a browser; that is signal's call, not a bug here

install.about: the unofficial bridge, as a container so a host needs no jre
install.source: verified from the image's own readme, nov 2026: MODE=native, /v1/qrcodelink, /v2/send

verify.about: the bridge answers and names the signal-cli it runs
one message from the phone's own chat list, read at the desktop

refused.bot-api: signal has no bot or app api. a getter that claims one is selling you a wrapper
refused.bulk: signal treats automation-heavy accounts as spam, so this rail is for people who talk to the agent
refused.scraping-the-desktop-app: driving the signal desktop binary is not a rail, it is a screenshot with extra steps

evidence: install and link commands verified against the image's own readme; nothing has been linked on this host
